from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party mentioned in the document with their role."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party (person or entity)")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case (e.g., appellant, appellee)")

class CostAllocation(BaseModel):
    """A specific court cost allocation record."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The monetary amount of the cost")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who is assigned to bear this cost")
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g., second instance filing fee)")

class Disposition(BaseModel):
    """A statement of the court's ruling or outcome."""
    text: str = Field(description="The ruling text, verbatim")

class CaseContext(BaseModel):
    """Metadata describing the case context."""
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of the case (e.g., civil dispute, administrative review)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    parties: list[Party]
    cost_allocations: list[CostAllocation]
    dispositions: list[Disposition]
    case_context: list[CaseContext]
